name: MKI Merge Versions
overview: Two resolutions, one entry. The 4K version leads.
description: Merges movies that exist in several resolutions into a single library entry, matched by TMDb ID (IMDb as fallback), never by title. The highest resolution becomes the primary version. Runs as a scheduled task and automatically once the library has been quiet for five minutes. Includes a dry-run mode.
changelog: New settings page in the shared MKI design. The header shows the merge task, the last result, the next run and the primary-version fix at a glance, with Run now and Stop. A timeline shows past and coming runs, and the latest MKI Merge log lines can be shown on demand. Settings save as soon as you change them, with undo; switching from dry run to live asks first. Works on phones and in light and dark themes.
